description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Strategic Development Project: Ceylon Tyre Manufacturing Company (Pvt.) Ltd. (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of a project under the Strategic Development Projects Act and outlines specific tax exemptions and regulatory benefits (Corporate Income Tax, VAT, Ports and Airport Development Levy, Customs duty). It involves legal/regulatory matters by implementing provisions of existing acts and ordinances, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
